summary: Two bounded BOUNDARY017 candidates are complete, pending the distinct critic. The first derives the exact selected-cofactor input, measure eta/V_H, full polynomial-group normalizer, outer rho damping, conjugation and factorization multiplicities. It distinguishes the accepted small-sift Mobius/long-factor array from a genuinely different factorwise polynomial sieve, whose balanced v0 entries are prime-supported with fixed signs. On an honest whole positive product rectangle only integer h1 occurs; the full difference is exactly (1-m_arc)|C1|^2 minus an unevaluated real signed fractional-sector form. The second refutes the literal all-precision ENERGY012 conclusion on this changed input: its principal character on a fixed positive-length time interval gives normalized energy at least c/(H log^4 H), even on powers of two. An auxiliary PNT target-average prime-plus-semiprime witness audits the raw error and thin projection scales. No isolated positivity is promoted to a total signed lower bound, accepted small-sift energy failure, pointwise prime margin, universal no-go, novelty or Goldbach. No experiment or helper code was run. Usage is unknown.

claims.text: The positive selected-divisor expression has exact cofactor amplitudes with explicit repeated-factor eligibility and outer damping. In the chosen balanced macroscopic-label box eligibility is automatic, h1 is the sole integer cofactor and the true factorable input has the stated Hilbert measure, full normalizer and conjugation.

The full protected-sector comparison gives D_H=(1-m_arc)|C1|^2-Q_fractional on that box, retaining actual fractional-state coefficients. Q_fractional is real but no sign or sufficiently small bound is proved, so the identity gives no total signed lower bound.

The inference that the accepted subpolynomial R_Z already makes balanced variables prime is refuted by surviving distinct-prime semiprimes. The additional factorwise polynomial sieve does force primality there but changes the arithmetic energy/decomposition family and does not inherit its analytic estimates.

Classical PNT/Mertens yield arbitrarily large even targets with a polynomial-sifted raw h1 contribution at least a constant times HY/(V_H^2 log^4 H). This prime-plus-semiprime average witness retains the thin actual endpoint projection and does not refute a total estimate without controlling fractional compensation.

The assertion that ENERGY012's all-precision zero-centered normalized energy bound survives the additional polynomial factorwise sieve is refuted: at trivial fixed twists and v=lambda=0, a principal-character phase-cone lower bound gives energy at least c/(H log^4 H) for every large even H in the explicit construction, including powers of two. This does not refute the accepted small-sift energy or a total signed comparison estimate.

Bounds for the accepted small-sift boundary convolution and its fractional comparison, a polynomial-sieve Type-I/energy extension, any pointwise prime margin, global novelty, a general impossibility claim and Goldbach remain unestablished.
